subject: Cascade renewal: invoice remit alias, PO & billing handoff
messages:
From: Liz Harmon <liz.harmon@cloudscale.com>
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood-inference.com>
Cc: procurement@cloudscale.com
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2027 09:12:00 -0800
Subject: Cascade renewal — invoice remit and PO timing

Hi Karthik,

We're starting the renewal process for our Cascade workspace (term ends 2027-12-31) and have a couple of procurement asks before finance can cut the PO:

- Can Redwood send the invoice to a billing alias (vendor_payments@cloudscale.com) rather than my personal email?
- We'll need Redwood's W-9 and the invoice remit address for the PO header.
- Finance prefers net45, but I know you usually default to net30 — any chance to discuss terms?
- Also confirm whether the quoted capacity includes the 10% burst bucket we discussed for Q1 usage spikes.

If you can share a revised quote and W-9, procurement will try to finalize the PO this week.

Thanks —
Liz Harmon
Head of Procurement (CloudScale)
liz.harmon@cloudscale.com
+1 415-555-0149
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood-inference.com>
To: Liz Harmon <liz.harmon@cloudscale.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood-inference.com>, Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood-inference.com>
Date: Tue, 10 Nov 2027 10:03:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: Cascade renewal — invoice remit and PO timing

Hi Liz — thanks for the heads up. Attaching an updated quote that explicitly calls out the 10% burst buffer for Q1, and our standard W-9.

Quick answers:
- We can route invoices to vendor_payments@cloudscale.com — we'll update the billing alias on the account once we receive the PO number and preferred invoice header.
- Remit address (for the invoice footer): Redwood Inference, Attn: Accounts Receivable, 2200 Bryant St, Suite 300, San Francisco, CA 94110. EIN: 81-2345678.
- Net terms: our standard is net30. Net45 is possible but requires a one-time credit review by our finance team (Kimberly is cc'd). If CloudScale needs net45, we can escalate — expect confirmation within 48 business hours.

Next steps from our side:
1) I've attached "Redwood_Quote_Cascade_2028.pdf" with the revised line items and an explicit capacity add-on row for the burst buffer.
2) Please send the PO (scan or DocuSign) and the exact invoice header you want.
3) Kimberly will confirm whether we can approve net45 for this account; Monica will coordinate the billing handoff and the invoicing cadence.

If you prefer a short call with AP to align headers and the SOW code, we can set that up today.

Best,
Karthik
Enterprise Account Executive
Redwood Inference
From: procurement@cloudscale.com
To: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood-inference.com>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood-inference.com>
Cc: Liz Harmon <liz.harmon@cloudscale.com>
Date: Wed, 11 Nov 2027 11:35:00 -08:00
Subject: CloudScale PO draft and invoice header

Karthik / Monica —

Attached is the PO draft (we'll circulate internally and sign once we confirm remit details). A few specifics for the PO header and invoice:

- Invoice To: CloudScale Inc.
  Attn: Accounts Payable
  vendor_payments@cloudscale.com
- PO number: CS-PO-6789 (we'll finalize this in the signature loop)
- Please include Project Code: CS-CloudScale-2028 on the invoice line and in the PDF filename for AP ingestion.
- We require Redwood's W-9 or EU tax registration (if you plan to bill from an EU entity) attached to the PO.

We prefer net45 but if Redwood requires net30 let us know who to escalate to; otherwise we'll sign with net45 pending your credit confirmation.

Procurement
CloudScale Inc.
From: Kimberly Park <kimberly_park@redwood-inference.com>
To: procurement@cloudscale.com, Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood-inference.com>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood-inference.com>, Liz Harmon <liz.harmon@cloudscale.com>
Date: Thu, 12 Nov 2027 09:18:00 -08:00
Subject: Re: CloudScale PO draft and invoice header

Hi all —

Thanks for the PO draft. Attaching our W-9 (W9_Redwood_Inference.pdf) here for your records. A couple of notes from finance:

- Remit: Redwood Inference, Attn: Accounts Receivable, 2200 Bryant St, Suite 300, San Francisco, CA 94110. EFT details will be provided on the initial PDF invoice once PO is received.
- Invoice header: please use the PO number as the invoice reference and include Project Code CS-CloudScale-2028 in the invoice body. This helps our reconciliation and will speed payment.
- Net terms: standard net30. To approve net45 we need a one-time credit memo filed; we can accept net45 for this PO if procurement confirms and signs the credit addendum (I can generate and loop in legal).
- Attachments on invoices: please include the signed PO (PDF) as a single attachment and a clear line-item CSV if you have split charges. AP will ingest PDFs via vendor_payments@cloudscale.com.

I'll mark this as high priority; if you want net45 today, please reply with the billing contact and an explicit approval line and we'll fast-track.

Regards,
Kimberly Park
Director, Revenue Operations
Redwood Inference
From: Liz Harmon <liz.harmon@cloudscale.com>

Date: Wed, 17 Nov 2027 15:04:00 -08:00

Thanks team — attaching the signed PO (CloudScale_PO_6789_signed.pdf).

Summary:
- PO: CS-PO-6789 (attached, signed).
- Invoice to: vendor_payments@cloudscale.com (please cc liz.harman@cloudscale.com for visibility).
- Project Code: CS-CloudScale-2028 must be present on invoice PDF filename and in the invoice body.
- We accept Redwood's default net30 if that removes any blocking steps on your side. If Redwood can do net45, great — otherwise we'll proceed with net30.

Karthik — please confirm once the account has been updated and the billing alias is set so AP gets the first invoice on receipt. Monica, if you can schedule a 15-minute handoff with our AP team (accounts-payable@cloudscale.com) that would be perfect.

Liz
From: Karthik Iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood-inference.com>

Received — thank you and congrats on getting that signed.

Action items I will own:
- Update CloudScale account to route billing to vendor_payments@cloudscale.com and set PO CS-PO-6789 as the primary invoice reference (expected by EOD PT).
- Send the initial PDF invoice (with Project Code CS-CloudScale-2028 in filename) once the account change is live — Kimberly will confirm net terms (we'll proceed as net30 unless she confirms net45).
- Monica will schedule the 15-minute handoff with accounts-payable@cloudscale.com — expect a calendar invite in the next 24 hours.

Attachments recorded in the thread: Redwood_Quote_Cascade_2028.pdf; W9_Redwood_Inference.pdf; CloudScale_PO_6789_signed.pdf.

Thanks — looking forward to another great year of partnership.
